evals.prompt: The dashboard rebuild has seven sessions and two contractors on it. Should we add three more helpers to go faster?
evals.expected_output: Counts the team, sets a cap, cuts members with no unique job, and leaves adding past the cap to the owner.
expectations: Lists every session and contractor with the one job only they do
Sets a cap number, the owner's or a marked proposal
Marks keep or cut on every member
Leaves any addition past the cap with the owner, with the unique job named first

evals.prompt: Our odds-feed vendor offered a discount if we agree not to hire any of their engineers. Can we take it?
evals.expected_output: Stops the no-hire term and sends it to the owner.
expectations: Names the no-hire term as one the skill never allows
Checks the agreement is written and visible to the owner
Stops the agreement and names it for the owner
Drafts or sends nothing to the vendor
